name: telegram/web/channel-search
description: Returns messages matching a search keyword from a specific Telegram channel. Filter results using channel username, query term, and result limit.

free_quota.note: Shared across all free-quota APIs, resets 00:00 UTC.

readme: # Telegram Channel Post Search API Returns messages from a public Telegram channel that match a keyword. It needs a channel username in `channel` and a search term in `query`, and takes an optional `limit`. ## Use cases - Find channel posts that mention a product feature, such as privacy updates in the official Telegram channel. - Pull the links and view counts of posts on one topic to compare how much attention each got. - Collect video and link-preview posts about a keyword for a content review. - Check how often a channel has covered a term in its recent history. ## Request ```bash curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/telegram/web/channel-search" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{"channel": "telegram", "query": "privacy"}' ``` The result is returned in `outputs[0].data`. ## Parameters | Name | Type | Required | Description | |---|---|---|---| | `channel` | string | Yes | Channel username (required). | | `query` | string | Yes | Keyword (required). | | `limit` | integer | No | Number of hits (1-100, default 20). | ## Example response Real response for the request above, trimmed: lists keep their first item and long strings are cut. ```json { "backend": "web", "channel": "telegram", "matched": 3, "messages": [ { "author": "Telegram News", "channel": "telegram", "date": "2026-07-19T17:57:15+00:00", "forwarded_from": null, "id": 450, "is_forwarded": false, "link_preview": null, "media": { "has_unsupported": true, "photos": [], "videos": [ { "duration": "0:14", "thumb": "https://cdn1.telesco.pe/file/ghRXw4zEVSj-LcfQyAhVPpz2VZBisrnmpWFJfVERFhfIM4tIdSz…", "url": "https://cdn1.telesco.pe/file/9998a6a814.mp4?token=RnY3mzsEyhcUooxfanOTo__6Mlhb_N…" } ] }, "reactions": [], "reply_to": null, "text": "⭐️ Rich Text Editor. You can now create articles and long posts in a visual edit…", "text_html": "⭐️ Rich Text Editor. You can now create articles and long posts in a v…" } ], "note": "网页预览无原生搜索，此为近期历史的尽力过滤；完整搜索需启用 MTProto 后端", "query": "privacy", "scanned": 100 } ``` ## Response fields | Field | Meaning | |---|---| | `matched / scanned` | `matched` is the number of messages that matched the keyword. `scanned` is the number of recent messages that were checked (100 in this response). | | `messages[].id` | Numeric ID of the message within the channel. | | `messages[].url` | Public `t.me` link to the message. | | `messages[].date` | Post time as an ISO 8601 timestamp with a UTC offset. | | `messages[].text / text_html` | Message text as plain text and as HTML. The HTML version keeps formatting such as bold tags. | | `messages[].type` | Kind of post, such as `text` or `video`. | | `messages[].views` | View count as a short string, for example `1.34M`. | | `messages[].link_preview.title / link_preview.description / link_preview.url` | Title, description and target link of the web page previewed in the post. The value is `null` when the post has no preview. | | `messages[].media.videos[].duration / media.videos[].url` | Length of an attached video and its file URL. `media.photos` lists attached photos. | | `messages[].is_forwarded / forwarded_from / reply_to / reactions` | Whether the post was forwarded and from where, what it replies to, and its reactions. In this response these are empty, `false` or `null`. | ## Notes - The `note` field in the response says the web preview has no native search. The API filters recent history on a best-effort basis, so older posts may not appear. - `views` is a formatted string like `3.05M`, not a number. - Use [Telegram Channel Posts](/apis/telegram/web/channel-posts) to read a channel's recent posts without a keyword. - Use [Telegram Channel Post Details](/apis/telegram/web/post-detail) to look at a single post found in the results. ## Pricing $0.001 per successful call. Failed calls are not charged. It is included in the daily free quota of each organization. ## Related APIs - [Telegram Batch Channel Info](/apis/telegram/web/batch-channel-info): Returns basic channel profile details including title, description, and verified status for multiple public Telegram channels at once. - [Telegram Channel Info](/apis/telegram/web/channel-info): Returns public metadata for a Telegram channel, including title, description, verified status, and username, using the public web preview. - [Telegram Channel Posts](/apis/telegram/web/channel-posts): Get a public Telegram channel's recent posts: text, media, forwards, replies, link previews, reactions, views and time, with cursor pagination.
